classes.description: Override or extend the styles applied to the component.

className.description: A CSS class name applied to the root element.

disabled.description: If true, the view cannot be switched. The switch button is hidden and a click on the label does nothing.

disableFuture.description: If true, disable values after the current date.

disablePast.description: If true, disable values before the current date.

format.description: Format used to display the date.

labelId.description: Id of the calendar text element. It is used to establish an aria-labelledby relationship with the calendar grid element.

monthIndex.description: Index of the month used for this header.

onMonthChange.description: Callback fired when the displayed month changes.

onViewChange.description: Callback fired when the view changes.

slotProps.description: The props used for each component slot.

sx.description: The system prop that allows defining system overrides as well as additional CSS styles.

timezone.description: The timezone used to compare dates.

root.description: Styles applied to the root element.

slotDescriptions.leftArrowIcon: Icon displayed in the left view switch button.
slotDescriptions.nextIconButton: Button allowing to switch to the right view.
slotDescriptions.previousIconButton: Button allowing to switch to the left view.
slotDescriptions.rightArrowIcon: Icon displayed in the right view switch button.
slotDescriptions.switchViewButton: Button displayed to switch between different calendar views.
slotDescriptions.switchViewIcon: Icon displayed in the SwitchViewButton. Rotated by 180° when the open view is year.
